name: RunAnywhere
long_description:
Inference research at the frontier. Our agents build the kernels for each chip, and Wally ships the tokens.

We're RunAnywhere (YC W26), a research-led inference company, and you can use frontier open models like GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Kimi K3 and MiniMax M3 on Wally today. Wally has an OpenAI-compatible API and the wally CLI, with zero data retention by default, and it works with OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, Hermes and Cline. Tell your agent: set up https://runanywhere.ai/SKILL.md

For AWS Trainium, trnRT is our open-source (Apache-2.0) LLM inference engine. Aman Swar and Sanchit Monga's post covers serving GLM-5.3-Flash on one Trainium2 box: https://runanywhere.ai/blog/glm-5-3-flash-trainium2-nki-megakernels

For on-device AI, the open-source RunAnywhere SDKs share a C++ core across Swift, Kotlin, React Native, Flutter, TypeScript and C++.

We publish how we measured each result, so you can judge whether it applies to your workload. Happy to help any YC founder running coding agents, long-context workloads or on-device models.
one_liner: Inference research at the frontier. Frontier open models on Wally.
